g.title: The harbour wall at night, in fog. Theo walks alone under the lamps. Caption: Port Ellis harbour. Two in the morning. Off panel: I told him not to wait. MAYA, off panel: Theo! Up here!
Theo stops and looks up at the lighthouse. THEO, quietly: Maya? Sound effect: KREEEK. FERRYMAN, off panel: She's been up there all night, lad.

Theo at the foot of the lighthouse stairs. Caption, inner voice: Two hundred steps. I counted them once. Sound effect: tik tik tik. MAYA, off panel: Bring the oil. Editor's note: See The Lighthouse, issue 1.
